verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's built-in agent Ari answers questions directly from the user's connected financial data, such as whether you can afford to hire, why spending went up, or how long cash lasts. It also proactively messages users when something moves, explaining what changed before they ask, and it runs one-line scenarios backed by an inspectable Model with lineage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prescriptive recommendations (suggestions are only implied through scenarios and answers), and independent or hands-on corroboration, since all evidence is vendor-claimed.
